name: betterCode() Rust 2026
description: German online Rust conference: Agent-Ready Rust in the AI era
note: online, German (some English talks); early-bird ticket and team discount in the shop; workshop 2 Dec
details:
Online conference by iX (heise) and dpunkt.verlag, theme "Agent-Ready Rust: Effizient ins KI-Zeitalter". Browser-based, with chat and video exchange; videos and slides afterwards.

Talks include Matthias Endler (systems design with Rust and agents), Stefan Baumgartner (maintainable Rust codebases), Orhun Parmaksiz (JetBrains, terminal tooling), Rainer Stropek (harness engineering for agentic development with Rust) and Niko Matsakis (AWS, "Rust in the Age of Agents"). Separate online workshop on 2 Dec (09:00-16:00): harness engineering for AI coding agents with Rust. Prices only in the ticket shop.
